articles.title: ‘Noor’: Arabic word for light can shine in faith, knowledge and affection
articles.dek: Whether cast by the sun or associated with a person’s presence, noor, the Arabic word for light, carries several meanings. Noor al-shams means sunlight, while noor al-qamar refers to moonlight. The plural is anwar, meaning “lights”. Noor comes from the root letters nun, waw and ra, which carry meanings associated with light and illumination.
